quote: Wake early if you want another's life or land. No lamb for the lazy wolf.
You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
When you have a choice and you choose not to act, that is a choice too.
The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance.
Opportunities multiply as they are seized.
Cattle die, kinsmen die, the self must also die; one thing never dies — the fame of a dead man's deeds.
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
You can't be afraid to fail. It's the only way you succeed.
Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed.
Victorious warriors win first and then go to war.
A wise man should know what he wants and how to get it — never by chance alone.
A man should not be too wise; let his wits keep stride with his luck.

Tell no man your secrets. Two are companions, three are a council.
Better gear than good sense a traveler cannot carry.
The strong are vulnerable. The brave can be broken. The wise can be deceived. No man is so good he has no flaw.
He alone knows who has wandered far and traveled the wide world over: what wits he meets when the time is hard.
A man should never step a foot beyond his weapons; the time of need is never known.
Praise the day at evening, the sword when tested, the ice when crossed, the ale when drunk.
Be a friend to your friend, match gift with gift; meet smiles with smiles, and lies with lies.

Better a sparrow in the hand than a crane in the sky.
Even a small mouse has anger.
Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
Confine yourself to the present.
The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury.
Begin each morning by saying to yourself: I shall meet the busybody, the ungrateful, the arrogant, the deceitful. Be present anyway.
Look well into thyself; there is a source of strength which will always spring up if thou wilt always look.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
He suffers more than necessary who suffers before it is necessary.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
While we are postponing, life speeds by.
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
Where there is no vision, the people perish.
He who guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
Better is a little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble with it.
Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another.
He who walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools will suffer harm.
Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.
A good name is more desirable than great riches.
He who is slow to anger is better than the mighty, and he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city.
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with all your might.
Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
An eye for an eye makes the whole world blind.
Train yourself in godliness; for bodily exercise profits a little, but godliness is profitable for all things.
I'm just a kid from Akron.
Nothing is given. Everything is earned.
I'm literally playing for an entire generation of kids — that's what pushes me.
I can accept failure — everyone fails at something. But I can't accept not trying.
I'm going to use all my tools, my God-given ability, and make the best life I can with it.
I don't need too much. Glamour doesn't excite me. I'm glad I have my health and my family.
Strive for greatness.
I treated my body like the temple it is, and now I'm reaping the rewards.
You don't get noticed by being normal. Your work has to speak for itself.
Go big or go home.
Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.
All warfare is based on deception.
Know yourself and you will win all battles.
In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
Appear weak when you are strong, and strong when you are weak.
The greatest victory is that which requires no battle.
He who knows when he can fight and when he cannot will be victorious.
To know your enemy, you must become your enemy.
Speed is the essence of war.
The wise warrior avoids the battle.
If you wait by the river long enough, the bodies of your enemies will float by.
Build your opponent a golden bridge to retreat across.
Do not press a desperate foe too hard.
When the enemy is relaxed, make them toil. When full, starve them. When settled, make them move.
Discipline equals freedom.
The future depends on what you do today.

The way you do anything is the way you do everything.
Comparison is the thief of joy.

The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
Out of suffering have emerged the strongest souls; the most massive characters are seared with scars.
Family is not an important thing — it's everything.
Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but whoever hates correction is stupid.
When you are inspired by some great purpose, all your thoughts break their bonds.
Build something today that your future self will thank you for.
